children: DataMeds AI entered a settlement, paying $450,000 to repurchase 364,099 shares and resolve related litigation.
$450,000 settlement paid: $350,000 for repurchase of 364,099 common shares and $100,000 to settle MIPA claims.
Company expects to extinguish approximately $19 million of liability on its consolidated balance sheet.
Settlement resolves litigation in Florida and Delaware and includes mutual releases and dismissal with prejudice.
